_meta.source: MOE post secondary admissions pages, MOE press releases on admission criteria changes for the first SEC cohort, ITE and polytechnic admissions pages
_meta.notes: Criteria apply to the first SEC cohort entering post secondary in 2028, admitted through the PSE (one exercise replacing the JAE, PFP and DPP exercises). Figures marked confirmed were corroborated against extracts of the primary MOE, SEAB and ITE pages plus two or more independent sources on 2026-08-05; the session could not open the primary pages end to end, so eyeball them once before students use this. Structural rules are evaluated by the app. Performance rules are never evaluated, because this app does not predict grades. Rows are ordered alphabetically by railName so the ordering is visibly arbitrary and cannot be read as prestige.

moe_sec.title: Full SBB and the SEC examination

moe_ite_upgraders.title: ITE upgrader admissions to polytechnics from AY2027

destinations.name: A fifth year at school
destinations.feels: Same school, one more year, subjects at a harder level.
destinations.leadsTo: The SEC again, then any route.

structural.label: Decided on results, not your plan

performance.label: Three or more G3 passes
performance.note: And not qualifying for JC, MI or Polytechnic Year 1.

performance.label: Or ELMAB3 21, ELB3 14, or MAB3 14 at G2
performance.note: With two or fewer G3 passes, and Grade 5 at G2 in every subject counted. Taking every fifth year subject at G3 needs ELMAB3 19.

alsoIn: It exists so one year does not decide everything.

destinations.name: NAFA and LASALLE
destinations.feels: You audition or show a portfolio. The work is the entry.
destinations.leadsTo: A diploma, then a degree or practice.

structural.label: Open from any combination of levels

performance.label: Portfolio or audition carries the most weight
performance.note: Results matter less here than anywhere else in the system.

alsoIn: Start a portfolio now. It does not depend on your levels.

destinations.name: ITE, Higher Nitec, straight into Year 2
destinations.feels: Hands on from week one, on the equipment the industry uses.
destinations.leadsTo: Higher Nitec, then work or poly.

structural.label: Five subjects at G2 or above

performance.label: ELMAB3 19 or better, at G2 grades
performance.note: From AY2028, this skips Year 1 of the same 3 year course. It replaced the DPP.

alsoIn: Early Admissions looks at interest, before results.

destinations.name: Junior College
destinations.feels: Fast and essay heavy. You narrow to a few subjects and go deep.

performance.label: L1R4 aggregate of 16 or better
performance.note: One language plus four relevant subjects at G3. This replaced L1R5 of 20.

performance.label: Grade floors in English, one Mathematics and Mother Tongue
performance.note: EL C6, a G3 Mathematics D7, MTL D7. Missing one can still mean conditional admission, so ask rather than assume.

alsoIn: Direct School Admission takes talent, before results.

destinations.name: Millennia Institute
destinations.feels: The same A Levels as JC, over three years instead of two.

performance.label: L1R4 aggregate of 20 or better
performance.note: Wider entry than JC's 16, on the same subject rules. The extra year is the design, not a consolation.

alsoIn: Some students choose the extra year on purpose.

destinations.name: ITE, 3 year Higher Nitec
destinations.duration: 3 years, or leave with a Nitec after 2
destinations.feels: Learn a trade by doing it, in a workshop, kitchen or studio.
destinations.leadsTo: Higher Nitec, then poly or work. Nitec marks the exit stop.

structural.label: Four subjects at G1 or above

performance.label: Built to take the whole range of the cohort
performance.note: Entry computed at G1 equivalent grades. Courses set their own subject requirements, and popular ones are competitive.

alsoIn: One course now, not two stacked ones. Leaving after Year 2 with a Nitec and returning later is a real road.

destinations.name: Polytechnic Foundation Programme
destinations.feels: A year inside the polytechnic, building the foundation your diploma needs.
destinations.leadsTo: Straight into Year 1 of a diploma.

structural.label: Five subjects at G2 or above

performance.label: ELMAB3 12 or better
performance.note: English, Mathematics and three best, all counted at G2 equivalent grades. G3 grades map down, so any mix of levels can apply from the 2028 intake.

alsoIn: You apply into a cluster of related courses, and the diploma at the end is the same as everyone else's.

destinations.name: Polytechnic
destinations.feels: You pick a field on day one and work in it. Labs, studios, an internship.
destinations.leadsTo: A diploma, then work or university.

performance.label: ELR2B2 22 or better
performance.note: One of the two best subjects may sit at G2 from the 2028 intake; 24 for Nursing. Each course adds its own requirements, published mid 2027.

alsoIn: Early Admissions can give you a place before results.
